name: framerhorizontalscroll
title: Framer Horizontal Scroll
description: A tall page pins a single strip of square photos across its middle and moves the whole strip sideways as you scroll down, so vertical scrolling becomes horizontal travel through the pictures.
use: A portfolio wants a long cinematic image sequence instead of a normal clickable slider.
avoid: The section is three screens tall and seizes the scroll, and sixteen large remote photos all load up front.
a11y: Every photo uses the placeholder alt text img, and the sideways drift ignores reduced-motion preferences. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A horizontal band of square photo tiles with small even gaps, running past both edges of a black page that has wide empty space above and below. The crops range from glass buildings and flowers to mountains and a concert hall.
behaves: Scrolling inside the tall section holds the strip at the same height while shifting the row leftwards, so new photos enter from the right and old ones exit on the left. The travel is tied directly to scroll distance, so it stops the moment scrolling stops.
customise: No props: the photo list is a module-level array of image links, and the 300 px tiles, gap and three-screen section height are classes in the source.
weight: moderate: Sixteen large remote photos load at once and a scroll listener drives the row.
